row.notes: myteam-g1: Starts the My Team driver contract window: finds slots with state 2/3 in the 0x68-byte slot array (comp+0x4dc, state byte +0x4e4, count +0x6f0), calls FUN_140db65c0/FUN_140db66b0 to switch slot state, asks the calendar (comp+0x298) for the meeting day (event 0x22) and stores the new meeting date at comp+0x468. Raises my_team_contract_window_opened.

verify.notes: V8994 Scans slots with state byte +0x4e4 == 2/3, calls FUN_140db65c0/db66b0, uses calendar comp+0x298 with event 0x22, stores the new meeting object (day+short) at comp+0x468. Matches the note.
